title: CST does not evict elongating telomerase but prevents initiation by ssDNA binding.
authors: Zaug, Arthur J; Lim, Ci Ji; Olson, Conner L; Carilli, Maria T; Goodrich, Karen J; Wuttke, Deborah S; Cech, Thomas R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CST复合物通过ssDNA结合抑制端粒酶延伸的机制，涉及蛋白-DNA结合与竞争性结合模拟，但非TF-DNA体系且方法以实验为主、模拟为辅，可借鉴其蛋白-DNA结合建模思路。
abstract: The CST complex (CTC1-STN1-TEN1) has been shown to inhibit telomerase extension of the G-strand of telomeres and facilitate the switch to C-strand synthesis by DNA polymerase alpha-primase (pol alpha-primase). Recently the structure of human CST was solved by cryo-EM, allowing the design of mutant proteins defective in telomeric ssDNA binding and prompting the reexamination of CST inhibition of telomerase. The previous proposal that human CST inhibits telomerase by sequestration of the DNA primer was tested with a series of DNA-binding mutants of CST and modeled by a competitive binding simulation. The DNA-binding mutants had substantially reduced ability to inhibit telomerase, as predicted from their reduced affinity for telomeric DNA. These results provide strong support for the previous primer sequestration model. We then tested whether addition of CST to an ongoing processive telomerase reaction would terminate DNA extension. Pulse-chase telomerase reactions with addition of either wild-type CST or DNA-binding mutants showed that CST has no detectable ability to terminate ongoing telomerase extension in vitro. The same lack of inhibition was observed with or without pol alpha-primase bound to CST. These results suggest how the switch from telomerase extension to C-strand synthesis may occur.
abstract_zh: CST复合物（CTC1-STN1-TEN1）已被证明能抑制端粒酶对端粒G链的延伸，并促进DNA聚合酶α-引物酶（pol alpha-primase）转向C链合成。近期，通过冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）解析了人源CST的结构，这使得设计在端粒单链DNA结合上存在缺陷的突变蛋白成为可能，并促使重新审视CST对端粒酶的抑制作用。先前提出的关于人源CST通过隔离DNA引物来抑制端粒酶的假说，已通过一系列CST的DNA结合突变体进行测试，并通过竞争性结合模拟进行建模。这些DNA结合突变体抑制端粒酶的能力显著降低，这与其对端粒DNA亲和力降低的预测相符。这些结果为先前的引物隔离模型提供了有力支持。随后，我们测试了在持续进行的持续性端粒酶反应中添加CST是否会终止DNA延伸。通过脉冲追踪端粒酶反应，并添加野生型CST或DNA结合突变体，结果显示CST在体外没有可检测到的能力来终止正在进行的端粒酶延伸。无论CST是否与pol alpha-primase结合，均观察到相同的缺乏抑制作用。这些结果提示了端粒酶延伸向C链合成转换的可能机制。
